scope: Sweep 6 — Cache + health + agents endpoints + global error handler
summary: 5 features × ~5 TCs = 27 TCs reviewed; 0 real defects. Cache: per-user namespacing prevents cross-user leak; TTL hard cap 24h via _MAX_TTL=86400; model_validator on action='set' requires value; default ttl when not specified = max. Health: 3 component check, all wrapped in try/except → ok=False on any exception; ANTHROPIC placeholder detection ('your-' prefix). Liveness probe is genuinely unauthenticated (no Depends, no router-level dep on app.get('/health')). Global error handler: dict-detail with 'error' key pass-through preserves project envelope shape; unhandled Exception → 500 with truncated exception in details (300 char cap).
notes: Note for /health: per .claude/rules/api.md, /health and /auth/* are explicitly exempt from auth. Verified main.py:117 has no Depends.
FEAT-080 leaks str(exc) to client (truncated 300 chars). Audit accepts as documented MVP tradeoff in code comments — single-user; revisit if multi-tenant.
